description: Ports extérieurs is a dataset listed in Observatoire du Développement Durable de Corse open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Direction régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement de Corse. Infrastructures portuaires continentales. Coverage: Corsica. Its keywords are portuaire, infrastructure, données ouvertes, maritime, port, transport. The portal shows 15 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2012-04-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-oddc-datacorsica-portal.
